channel.description: The morning brief: what happened in security since the last episode, for the people who patch things.

item.title: N-central’s fourth hotfix, and routers under attack
item.description: Four N-central hotfixes in five weeks, and even the previous day’s update isn’t enough. It’s Monday, the seventh of September, twenty twenty-six. I’m George, and this is The morning brief: public router exploits, database and Java traps, then active attacks on remote management platforms and online shops.
